ticker_news.title: Is AMD Building the Next AI Superstack? Inside Its 2025 Acquisition Spree
ticker_news.description: AMD is aggressively expanding its AI capabilities through a series of acquisitions in 2025, aiming to challenge NVIDIA's dominance in the AI GPU and infrastructure market. The company's recent partnerships with major tech firms like OpenAI, Microsoft, and Oracle further solidify its growing importance in the AI revolution.
ticker_news.author: Marketbeat.Com
